entities.name: Ivan Voronaev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
This American immigrant introduced Pentecostalism to Russia, Ukraine and some other Slavic nations. The first Russian-language Pentecostal church in Manhattan was founded by 
Voronaev in 1919.
